remember_me.label: Keep me signed in on this device

city_other.label: Which city?
city_other.placeholder: Type the name of your city

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Free, no card. When you finish you go back to the lesson you were watching.
register.note: We use your data only to give you access to the courses and to tell you when we publish a new one.

email_taken.message: That email already has an account.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: You pick up where you left off.

google_account.message: This account was created with Google. Sign in with Google and you are in.

forgot_password.title: Recover your password
forgot_password.subtitle: Type your email and we send you a link to change it. The link expires in an hour.

sent.title: The link is on its way
sent.description: If that account exists, the link is already on its way.
sent.hint: The link expires in an hour and works only once.

check_email.title: Check your email
check_email.description: We sent a verification link to {{email}}. Open it so you can comment on the lessons.
check_email.secondary: Meanwhile you can already watch every course: verification is only needed to write comments.
check_email.footer: If it does not arrive in five minutes, check spam or write to us at hola@arxatec.pe.

reset_password.title: Pick a new password
reset_password.subtitle: Type it twice and you sign in with it from now on.

success.title: Password changed
success.description: We closed the other sessions for safety. Sign in with your new password.

expired.title: That link no longer works
expired.description: Links expire in an hour and work only once. Ask for another one and you get it by email.

missing_token.title: The link is missing
missing_token.description: Open the link from the email exactly as it arrived, without trimming it.

success.title: Email verified
success.description: You can now comment on the lessons.

expired.title: That link no longer works
expired.description: Verification links expire in 24 hours. Ask for another one and you get it by email.

signed_out.description: Verification links expire in 24 hours. Sign in and we send you another one.

missing_token.title: The link is missing
missing_token.description: Open the link from the email exactly as it arrived, without trimming it.

signed_out.description: Open the link from the email exactly as it arrived. If you no longer have it, sign in and we send you another one.

error.title: We could not sign you in with Google
error.description: The access code expires in a minute. Try again.

session_expired.title: Your session expired
session_expired.description: For safety we close the session after 30 days without use. Sign in and you go back to this same lesson, at the minute where you left it.

errors.token_invalid: That link no longer works: it expired or someone already used it.
errors.invalid_credentials: The email or the password does not match.
errors.unauthenticated: You need to sign in to continue.
errors.session_expired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.email_not_verified: Verify your email so you can comment.
errors.not_found: We did not find what you were looking for.
errors.email_already_registered: That email already has an account.
errors.account_uses_google: This account was created with Google. Sign in with Google.
errors.resend_cooldown: Wait {{seconds}} s before asking for another link.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
errors.retry_later: Wait a moment and try again.
errors.internal_error: Something failed on our side. Try again.
errors.email_invalid: That email does not look valid.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.return_path_invalid: That destination is not valid. We are taking you to the catalog.

validation.email_invalid: That email does not look valid.
validation.password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
validation.organization_required: Type the name of your firm or organization.
